postings.title: Detection Engineer
postings.description: Join DEFION as a Detection Engineer in Barcelona. Design advanced detection rules for SIEM, EDR, and XDR. Turn offensive findings into real-world defenses.

postings.title: IT Security Internship
postings.description: Graduation internship in cybersecurity at DEFION Security. Work on a real research project, learn from top experts, and get paid €500/month with free lunch and a laptop.

postings.title: Medior SOC Analyst
postings.description: Join DEFION's SOC team as a Medior Analyst. Work with Microsoft Defender and Sentinel, collaborate with threat hunters and DFIR specialists, and protect clients 24/7.

postings.title: New Business Developer
postings.description: Join DEFION Security as a New Business Developer. Build and manage the client portfolio of a fast-growing security company. Not an account manager maintaining existing relationships, but a hunter who opens new doors with C-level and IT decision-makers.

postings.title: Senior Security Specialist
postings.description: Join DEFION as a Senior Security Specialist. Execute offensive security assessments, specialize in cloud, red teaming, or governance, and shape your own role.

postings.title: SOC Analyst
postings.description: Join DEFION's Barcelona SOC as a Security Analyst. Monitor EDR/SIEM alerts, investigate threats, apply threat intelligence, and respond to incidents in an international team.
